cases.job_text:
Exponet is an advanced platform for process management, project management, and automation in the construction and infrastructure industries. We are looking for someone who not only knows how to sell, but also enjoys working with software, understands technology, learns quickly, and knows how to present a complex system in a simple, clear, and compelling way.

What will you do?
Develop an in-depth understanding of the Exponet platform, including its capabilities, modules, workflows, and solutions.
Conduct product demonstrations and sales presentations for potential customers, generated by the SDR team.
Lead online sales meetings and product demos via Teams and Zoom.
Conduct face-to-face meetings with customers when needed.
Manage the sales process end-to-end — from the initial inquiry and identifying customer needs, through product demonstrations and all the way to advancing the deal.
Understand customer needs and workflows and demonstrate how Exponet can improve and streamline their operations.
Work with developers, construction companies, project management and supervision firms, public organizations, and other companies across the industry.

Who are we looking for?
Experience working with Web-based systems – required.
Strong technical orientation with Web systems, and digital tools.
Ability to quickly and independently learn a complex system with a wide range of capabilities.
Strong presentation skills and confidence when demonstrating software to customers.
Ability to lead professional sales meetings mostly online but also face-to-face.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build strong relationships and trust with customers.
Customer-oriented mindset combined with a strong sales orientation and the ability to drive a process forward.
Experience or familiarity with the construction industry, infrastructure, project management, or project management systems — a significant advantage.

Why join Exponet?
Work with an advanced technology platform that is at the core of operations for organizations and projects in the construction and infrastructure industries.
A role that combines technology, people, and sales.
Work with a wide range of leading companies and organizations.
A professional, dynamic, and supportive work environment.
Competitive salary + performance-based commissions.

Company Description
PipeFX builds the systems behind creative and media production at scale — the pipelines, services and tooling that turn a good idea into something that runs reliably, every time.
We're a small, senior team, and we work the way we think software is going in 2026: heavy use of AI and agentic tooling, short paths from idea to production, and very little process for its own sake. Clean architecture and maintainable code matter here — not as slogans, but because we ship fast and have to live with what we built.
If you join us, you'll be in production code early. You'll have senior engineers to learn from, and you'll be expected to have opinions. We hire on what people can build, and we make room for people to grow into more than they were hired for.
PipeFX is committed to inclusive hiring and to building a team where everyone has a real shot at doing their best work.
Role Description
As a Junior Software Engineer at PipeFX you'll work on back-end features and services — designing, building, testing and maintaining pieces of our core platform.
Day to day, that looks like:
- Turning loosely defined requirements into working technical solutions, alongside senior engineers
- Writing clean, efficient code and taking code review seriously — both directions
- Debugging, refactoring, and writing unit and integration tests
- Deploying updates, watching how they behave in production, and responding when something breaks
- Documenting what you built so the next person doesn't have to reverse-engineer it
What we care about most: that you can take a vague problem, break it down, and drive it to a result without needing someone to hand you the next step.
hybrid, on-site in Ramat Gan.
Qualifications
What you need:
- Hands-on experience writing back-end code in at least one modern language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) — from studies, work, or your own projects
- Understanding of APIs, databases and server-side frameworks
- Comfort with OOP principles and applying them in actual projects, not just in theory
- Git and standard development workflow — branching, pull requests, code review
- Strong problem-solving instincts, attention to detail, and clear communication in writing and in person
What will make you stand out:
- Things you've built. A repo, a product that went live, a bot, an internal tool, a side project nobody asked for. We'd rather open something you made than read another bullet point.
- Working fluently with AI and agentic dev tools — not "I've tried Copilot," but actually shipping with them
- Artistic point of view
